offers_products.reason: Offers annuities, life insurance and retirement plan administration, which count as insurance and financial services, not goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Life insurance, annuities and retirement plan recordkeeping for employers; insurers count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individuals buy annuities and life insurance and participate in retirement plans.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Manages retirement plans for non-profits and other employers and institutions; sells through financial professionals.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing premiums, annuity and retirement plan balances, and plan administration fees repeat over many years.

cyclical_demand.reason: Insurance and retirement savings are protective, long-term needs that customers rarely drop in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Premiums and retirement plan contributions are regular payments, though annuities can be large single deposits.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from insurance balance sheet, annuity spreads and plan fees, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individuals and households plus non-profit and employer plan sponsors, not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Insurer holding financial investments; no plants, fleets or networks needed to grow.

notes: Mix of consumer and plan-sponsor buyers is judged from the website text.
